collection.title: Audi A7 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A7 2018 Onwards model which requires a 25" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE - THE VF979 IS A SPECIAL ORDER PART - PLEASE ALLOW AN EXTRA 2-3 WORKING DAYS.
